subject: dragonfly
pitch: An emperor dragonfly hovering above a pond. A long, slim abdomen in electric blue with black markings down its back, an apple-green thorax, huge wraparound turquoise eyes, and four glassy wings with a fine net of dark veins and a faint golden sheen, held flat and wide. Six thin legs are tucked under it.

I'm sizing it realistically, around 8-9 cm body length with an 11 cm wingspan matching a real emperor dragonfly, and picking a reasonable hover height so the lowest point sits well above the floor.

Given the real-world scale, the abdomen comes out quite thin (a few millimeters), so I'm balancing accurate dragonfly proportions against the stylized, bold-shapes direction by keeping chunkier eyes and thorax while staying close to true size (~8 cm body length).
